mechanism: A meta-cognitive {{think}} operation that pauses direct problem-solving to ask a higher-level question. Instead of answering 'How do I X?', it asks 'What category of {{problem}} is X?' or 'What principles govern X?'. This abstraction reveals structural patterns invisible at the ground level. It is the precursor to {{reframe}}—gaining altitude before choosing a new direction.
failure_modes: Over-abstraction: Climbing so high the original problem becomes unrecognizable.
Analysis Paralysis: Endless stepping back without returning to action.
Premature Descent: Jumping back down before gaining useful perspective.
Abstraction Mismatch: Wrong principles retrieved for the task.
invariants: Output is at a higher abstraction level than its input.
Ascends at most `max_ascent_depth` levels, then descends.
Returns to the object-level {{problem}}; the ascent is a pause, not an exit.

parameters.name: max_ascent_depth
parameters.description: Levels of abstraction this may climb before descent is forced.
